spans.s:
r. 1st cl. (खर्लति)
1 To gather.
2 To move.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
1 Low, vile, base.
2 Low, inferior.
3 Cruel, mischievous, mischief-making.
4 Bad, wicked.
mn. (-लः-लं)
1 Earth, mould or soil.
2 Place, site.
3 Sediment, deposit of oil, &c.
4 A granary, a threshing floor.
5 A mill.
m. (-लः)
1 The sun.
2 A tree with black blossoms: see तमाल.
3 The Datura plant.
E.
खल to gather, (misfortune, &c.) affix अच्.

m. (-ल्लः)
1 A kind of cloth or clothes, leather garments.
2 A canal, a cut, a creek, a trench, a deep hole.
3 The Cātaka, a kind of cuckoo.
4

Leather.
5

A leather water bag.
6 A mill, a stone or vessel for grinding drugs, &c.
f. (-ल्ली)
Shooting pain in the extremities.
E.
खल collecting, &c. and ल what gets; also खल्लक m. (-कः)

f. (-ता)
1 Wickedness, villainy.
2 Filthiness.
E.
खल, and तल् affix; also with त्व affix खलत्वं.

mfn. (-तिः-तिः or -ती-ति)
Bald, baldheaded.
E.
स्खल to fall, Uṇādi affix अतच, इ inserted, and स rejected.

mf. (-पूः)
A sweeper, a cleaner, Mehter or Ferash.
E.
खल place, and पू who cleans, from पूञ् to cleanse or purify, affix क्विप्.

f. (-तिः)
The friendship or favour of wicked or low persons.
E.
खल, and प्रीति affection.

m. (-र्त्तिः)
Quicksilver.
E.
खल place, and मूर्त्ति form; taking the form of the place it lies in.

m. (-र्गः)
Associating with bad company.
E.
खल, संसर्ग associating.

f. (-रा)
A cockroach.
E.
खल the sediment of oil, and आधार having.

m. (-लिः)
Sediment of oil or oil-cake.
E.
खल to gather, इन् aff.

mfn. (-ली-लिनी-लि)
Having sediment, &c.
f. (नी)
1 A multitude of threshing floors.
2 A plant, (Anthericum tuberosum.)
E.
खल, and इनि aff.

mn. (-नः-नं)
The bit of a bridle: see खलीन.

mn. (-नः-नं)
The bit of a bridle.
E.
ख the mouth, and लीन what is fixed; also the vowel being made short खलिन.

mf. (-शः-शा)
A kind of fish, (Trichopodus colisa, HAM.) also खलेश.

m. (-रः)
1 Mischief, evil.
2 Leaving or reducing to sediment.
E.
खल mischievous, and कार who makes; च्चि inserted.

ind.
1 A particle of prohibition.
2 An expletive.
3 An expression of endearment or conciliation.
4 An expression indicating inquiry.
5 An expression of asseveration or ascertainment, (certainly, indeed.)
6 Only, merely.
E.
खल to gather, affix उ.

m. (-लुक्)
Darkness.
E.
ख the sky, लुक् dropped, lost, from लुज to efface, affix क्विप्.

m. (-षः)
A kind of wild animal; also खलुरेषक.

f. (-का)
A parade, a place for military exercise.
E.
खडि to break, ऊरच् affix, ड changed to ल, and कन् added.

f. (-नी)
The post of a threshing floor, round which the oxen pass who tread out the grain; also खलेवाली.

f. (-ली)
A post: see the preceding.
E.
खल a threshing floor in the seventh case, and बाली what is firm, a post, &c. from बल to be strong, अण् and ङीष affs.

m. (-शः)
A kind of fish, (commonly Trichopodus colisa, HAM.) see खलिश.
E.
खले in dirt, and श from शी to sleep; burrowing in the mud of the banks, &c.

m. (-यः)
The Khaliśa fish: see the preceding.
E.
as before, शी, and अच् aff.

f. (-क्तिः)
Abuse, low or wicked language.
E.
खल, and उक्ति speech.

mfn. (-ल्यः-ल्या-ल्यं)
Fit for oil cake, for a threshing floor, &c.
f. (-ल्या)
A multitude of threshing floors.
E.
खल a threshing floor, affix क्यप् यत् or य.

f. (-का)
A frying pan.
E.
कन् added to the preceding, fem. form.

mfn. (-टः-टा-टं)
Bald, morbidly troubled with falling of the hair; also खल्लीट.

mfn. (-टः-टा-टं)
Becoming morbidly bald: see the preceding.

m. (-टः)
A severe cough.

f. (-का)
A frying pan.

n. (-त्य)
Morbid baldness.
E.
खलति, and यञ् aff.
